label: Variant Picker
purpose: Allow customers to select product variants (size, color, style, etc.) and optionally show quantity-break pricing tiers
_notes: picker_types is a COMMA-SEPARATED list, one entry per product option, choosing its widget: 'pills', 'dropdown', 'swatches', 'quantity breaks', or 'hidden' (e.g. 'swatches, dropdown, quantity breaks'). custom_labels is a comma-separated override of each option's displayed label; supports [count], [name], [name_lowercase], [name_uppercase], [selected] placeholders; leave empty to use the real option name. All breaks_* fields ONLY apply when one option's picker_types entry is 'quantity breaks', and are each a COMMA-SEPARATED list with one entry per quantity-break tier — use '[empty]' to skip a tier. Supported placeholders across these fields: [name], [price], [compare_price], [amount_saved], [amount_saved_rounded]. skip_unavailable hides and auto-skips sold-out variants. Excluded as pure visual/technical: append (sizing-chart position), swatches_size, swatches_custom_colors(_list), full_width_dropdowns, breaks_style, breaks_prices_layout, breaks_display_selected_indicator, breaks_border_radius/width, breaks_color_scheme, breaks_vertical_items_align, breaks_badge_style/color, breaks_custom_images (a raw URL list the AI should not hallucinate), breaks_image_width, breaks_space_images, breaks_vertical_images_position, breaks_benefit_position/style/color, margins.
